items.entry: Dare to Dream at UTS is where my engineering curiosity started becoming real. Before that it was a vague idea; after it, it turned into something I actually wanted to keep exploring — starting with civil engineering, but I'm not locking anything in yet. UTS ran the Dare to Dream program for girls interested in stepping into fields where men are the majority. The program offered a variety of hands-on workshops, and women working in industry came to share their experiences, including Alex Skougarevskaya, Head of Design at Canva, and Ella Grier, AI Customer Engineer at Google Cloud. Hearing their stories first-hand pushed me to look into other careers, and my curiosity about engineering kept growing.
